name: How long does it take to fix a sewage smell problem?

mainEntity.name: How long does it take to fix a sewage smell problem?

acceptedAnswer.text: The time required to fix a sewage smell varies significantly based on the diagnosis. Simple fixes, such as refilling a dry P-trap or clearing a minor drain clog, might take less than an hour. More involved repairs, like replacing a toilet's wax ring or repairing a vent pipe, could take a few hours. We aim to complete most repairs efficiently while ensuring quality workmanship.
acceptedAnswer.description: Repair time varies; simple fixes take under an hour, while complex issues like wax ring or vent pipe repair could take several hours.
